_meta.description: ILM for agent-monitors-cache-reset-cadence-* (monthly index agent-monitors-cache-reset-cadence-YYYY-MM; ADR-0092 §D7 / FRE-572 frozen-reset cadence monitor, one doc per firing). min_age-based delete from origination date (no rollover write-alias). Retention: 123d (owner rule 2026-10-03: a monthly index keeps the current month plus 3 full months; the longest 4-month run is 123 days; was 90d) — no prior precedent, owner-approved 2026-07-31 (FRE-1036) as the operational-diagnostics default (matches agent-monitors-slm-health-policy's category). warm forcemerge fires at 32d, matching the user-turn-ratings-policy precedent so the current monthly index isn't merged while still open. Authored in FRE-1036; this family previously had no ILM policy (0 live indices at authoring time — rare event, gated on a frozen-reset firing).
